Dear Meena

I got the following error message during installation.
uninstallation R through control panel, deletion of R folder, and paussing antivirus program didn't solve the problem.

* installing *source* package 'MSstats' ...
** R
Error in parse(outFile) :
  invalid multibyte character in parser at line 369
ERROR: unable to collate and parse R files for package 'MSstats'
* removing 'C:/Program Files/R/R-3.0.3/library/MSstats'
Warning messages:
1: running command '"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-30~1.3/bin/i386/R" CMD INSTALL -l "C:\Program Files\R\R-3.0.3\library" "C:/Users/AA/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpIhaEHW/MSstats_2.1.6.tar.gz"' had status 1
2: In install.packages(path, repos = NULL, type = "source") :
  installation of package 'C:/Users/AA/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpIhaEHW/MSstats_2.1.6.tar.gz' had non-zero exit status


R and other packages were always successfully installed.
How can I solve this problem?
FYI, My OS is Windows 7 Ultimate K (64 bit).
